title: Fewer words, your first icons
thisBuild: The text diet: the playing pages no longer explain themselves. What the FAQ (the ? in the top bar) says what anything is, and the lessons show how. Page help in What the FAQ brings the old explanations back if you want them.
The FannyPack's + is now four colored tiles with icons: Keys, FX, LFO and XY. Lit tiles are packed.
Shorter lines where a note had to stay (an empty pack, an empty bank, an empty song).
watch: Is anything now hard to figure out without its explanation? Send a note saying which, and I'll make its FAQ line clearer.
The pack tiles: do the icons read at a glance?
limits: Icons only on the pack tiles so far. The Pro looks, with icons on every bar, come next.
